exposure: Gestational carriers with a history of preterm birth
Gestational carriers with a history of cesarean section
cohort: 836 gestational carriers from one of the largest surrogacy agencies in California between 2008 and 2018
finding: Both primary cesarean section and preterm birth rates in singleton gestational carrier pregnancies are higher than national averages, with cesarean section rates independent of maternal factors like age, BMI, and interpregnancy interval, and preterm birth rates primarily influenced by the gestational carrier's obstetric history.
mod_finding: In gestational carriers with a history of cesarean section, vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) rates were higher than national averages and were influenced by maternal age and BMI.
